title: 2021-03-03 Ordna Security meeting re: Cloud
content:
Date: 3rd of March 2021

Attendees: from DevOps, from Ordna.

During the meeting we discussed the onboarding to Ordnas production subscription in Azure.

IPEX is currently developing firm guidelines on how we handle access but these are currently not in place. The general idea currently is to grant the whole team Reader rights to the subscription but only a select few, the PO/SO and 1 or 2 leads from the team, full Contributor rights. This is to reduce the risk of accidentally removing or altering resources in an unsafe manner.

This however is primarily applicable to when teams are using both non-production as well as production in the “intended” way. In Ordnas case they will primarily use Azure to host builds and models and use these for both environments it makes little sense to host the models in two environments.

The team has been granted full access to the subscription. They have been made aware of that with this access there is an inherent risk and that they need to be very careful when navigating the portal.

The team mentioned that they would be interested in setting up a workflow in Github Actions to handle the Terraform work which we fully agree with and support. The Kombinera team is currently doing this and can be of support for the Github Actions specific knowledge.

The Ordna team will grant us access to their AWS accounts using the documentation found here: AWS - DevOps Team Cross Account Access

has been informed.
